title: Céad Míle Fáilte Irish Cottage Figurine – Hand-Painted Resin Miniature
descriptionText:
Bring a touch of Ireland into your home with this charming hand-painted Irish cottage figurine featuring the traditional thatched roof and stone walkway design. The front reads “Céad Míle Fáilte”, meaning “A Hundred Thousand Welcomes” in Irish Gaelic — a warm expression of hospitality and friendship.
This detailed piece beautifully captures the rustic charm of traditional Irish country homes, complete with flower pots, greenery, and textured stonework. Perfect as a decorative piece, souvenir, or thoughtful gift for lovers of Irish culture.
Features:
Hand-painted resin cottage with intricate detailing
Text on front: “Céad Míle Fáilte” (Irish for “A Hundred Thousand Welcomes”)
Thatched-style roof, flower pots, and stone path detailing
Great for collectors or as an Irish-themed decor piece
